Blockchain technology works like a shared digital record book that is not controlled by any single person or company. Instead of one central authority keeping the records, the information is spread out across many computers, which makes the system secure and open for everyone to see.

In this system, transactions are grouped together into "blocks." Once a block is verified and added to the chain, it cannot be changed or deleted. This is because each block is cryptographically linked to the one before it, creating a permanent and unbreakable chain of history. This design makes it extremely difficult for anyone to commit fraud or tamper with the data.
